description: This file defines a PHP class 'EventMigrationStatsDetail' that models detailed statistics for event migrations within the SuiteCRM CalendarSync module. It includes properties for event identification, messages, and types, and provides a string representation method.

classes.name: EventMigrationStatsDetail
classes.description: A class representing detailed statistics of event migration processes, including event identifiers, messages, reasons, and a type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the EventMigrationStatsDetail object with properties: type, event_id, event_name, message, and reason.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, summarizing its event ID, name, type, message, and reason.
